leads.name: St. Mary Star of the Sea Gumbo-limbo (National Co-Champion)
leads.location_hint: Basilica of St. Mary Star of the Sea, 1010 Windsor Lane, Key West
leads.reason: 2026-10-14 pass. Florida champion register PK 214 (read via Wayback): National Co-Champion 2014-03-10, circumference 104 in (264 cm), 36 ft (11 m), crown 66x54 ft, measured 2013-09-16, condition Good, owner St Mary's Star of the Sea Church. The register longitude -80.79514 is a typo (Key West is near -81.79); do not use it. Register location text: south of the schoolyard gate and east of another gumbo limbo and a West Indian mahogany, so it may stand on school grounds, and no source says the public can reach it (hard rule 10: schools only with evidence the grounds are open). No search result mentions this tree at all. Alive: register 2013 only. No photo, no pin. Ships with an access statement from the church or a reader photograph taken from the public side.

leads.name: Key West Garden: Cuban Lignum Vitae and Barringtonia (Boardwalk)
leads.species: Lignum-vitae (Guaiacum officinale) and Sea Putat (Barringtonia asiatica)
leads.location_hint: Key West Tropical Forest & Botanical Garden, 5210 College Rd, Stock Island; register points 24.57383,-81.74931 and 24.57389,-81.74927 (7 m apart)
leads.reason: 2026-10-14 pass. Florida register PK 1076 lignum vitae, Florida Champion, 30 in (76 cm), 19 ft, measured 2018-02-27; PK 1074 Barringtonia, Florida Champion, 30 in (76 cm), 30 ft, measured 2018-02-27. Garden's own page (Wayback 2024-07-21) lists both 'OK' and calls Barringtonia 'Former Champion' (conflict with the register's 2018 title, unresolved) and lignum vitae 'State Champion'. Garden is a paid 11-acre garden, not a small site; coordinates are register points, no per-tree evidence; no photograph found (Commons geosearch near the Boardwalk shows only butterfly photos); admission price and hours not seen on a fetched page (keywest.garden champion-trees page does not state them). Small trees (76 cm girth) whose reason to visit is the champion title only. Not rich: ships with the garden's price/hours from a fetched page plus a photograph or confirmed pin.
